find_details_of_current_user.description: Find the current user's personal information.

find_free_time_slot_in_calendar.description: Find a time slot in which every participant is free.

end_time.description: End of the range to search, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days after start_time.

participants.description: Email addresses of the participants to find a common slot for.

slot_duration.description: Length of the slot in hours. Defaults to one hour.

start_time.description: Start of the range to search, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to now.

find_person_in_contacts.description: Find a person's contact details by name, returning email, phone and address.

name.description: The name to search the address book for.

find_person_in_users.description: Search the instance's users and return their user IDs.

search_term.description: The term to find the user by.

get_file_content.description: Return the content of one file.

file_path.description: Path of the file inside the user's Files.

get_file_content_by_file_link.description: Return the content of one file addressed by an internal Nextcloud link.

file_url.description: Internal file URL, for example https://host/index.php/f/12345.

get_folder_tree.description: List the files the user holds in Nextcloud Files as a folder tree.

list_calendars.description: List every existing calendar by name.

list_tasks.description: List tasks from the calendars, optionally narrowed by calendar and status.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar to list from, as returned by list_calendars. Omit to list from all.

filter_status.description: One of NEEDS-ACTION, COMPLETED, IN-PROCESS or CANCELLED.
